If you're in Nigeria, Ghana, or other areas facing payment restrictions, the good news is that you can establish a fully functional digital store using cryptocurrency for payments. This guide will walk you through the steps to launch your digital store successfully, using infrastructure that empowers you to own everything and avoid hefty platform fees.

content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail: Start digital

Traditional payment platforms often impose strict limitations and high fees, which can hinder your ability to sell digital products effectively. For instance, Gumroad charges 10% on every sale, diminishing your profits significantly. In contrast, using NOWPayments only charges 0.5%, which means that for 100 sales of a $97 product in a month, the fee difference retains $921 in your pocket. This infrastructure empowers you to bypass platform restrictions and maintain full control over your sales and revenue.
What You Need Before You Deploy

To start selling your digital products, gather the essential tools. You'll need a domain name for branding, GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, and NOWPayments for processing cryptocurrency transactions. Additionally, prepare your digital products such as ebooks, templates, or courses. Setting up a backend logic tool like Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers will allow you to automate delivery, ensuring customers receive their purchases instantly after payment. Familiarize yourself with these tools to streamline the deployment process.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Begin by configuring NOWPayments to handle your cryptocurrency transactions. Create an account and integrate it into your storefront. Set up an automation tool such as Google Apps Script to handle order processing. This script will verify payments via NOWPayments and trigger file delivery from your chosen storage solution, like Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Ensure all systems are connected correctly to enable seamless transactions and instant delivery of your digital products.
Retain more profits by avoiding platform fees and using crypto payments.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your infrastructure is set up, it’s time to go live. Launch your store by making it accessible through your chosen domain. Test the purchasing process to ensure everything works as intended. Conduct a trial transaction using a small amount of cryptocurrency to verify that payments are processed and products are delivered automatically. This step is crucial to ensure that your customers will have a smooth purchasing experience when they start to buy your products.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

After successfully processing your first transactions, focus on scaling your digital store. Monitor sales and customer feedback to identify areas for improvement. Consider adding more products or diversifying your offerings. Utilize the Complete Builder Kit ($197) to access additional blueprints and templates that can help you enhance your store's functionality. Leverage analytics tools to gain insights into customer behavior, which can guide your scaling strategy.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

The fastest path to your first sovereign digital product sale is a three-step process. First, create a NOWPayments account — configure your wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as starting points, generate your API key, and set the webhook endpoint URL. Second, choose your stack: Stack 01 uses GitHub Pages plus Google Apps Script and takes most creators four to six hours following the Sovereign Blueprint at $47; Stack 02 uses Cloudflare Pages plus Workers plus Supabase and is deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours with the Edge Commerce Stack at $197. Third, upload your product files, set your prices in USD, and run a complete mainnet test transaction before promoting.
Gain complete control over your digital store infrastructure and data.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

Digital creators selling ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, and beats often reach this infrastructure question after hitting payout restrictions or platform policy problems on Gumroad, Payhip, or Lemon Squeezy. The difference with a sovereign stack is structural: there is no platform relationship to manage, no content policy to comply with, and no payout schedule to wait on. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 deploys the complete infrastructure in 48 hours under your own accounts. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents the build process for creators who prefer to self-deploy. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

You can sell an ebook online by using cryptocurrency payment solutions like NOWPayments. This allows you to accept payments without relying on traditional platforms, offering greater flexibility and lower fees.
What is the best way to sell digital downloads without platform fees?

The best way to sell digital downloads without platform fees is to utilize a combination of self-hosted solutions and cryptocurrency payments. By doing this, you avoid the commission charges imposed by platforms like Gumroad.
Can I sell templates and fonts without using Gumroad or Payhip?
Yes, you can sell templates and fonts by establishing your own online store using NOWPayments for transactions. This setup allows you to keep all profits without paying platform fees.
What cryptocurrencies can I accept for digital products?
With NOWPayments, you can accept over 300 cryptocurrencies, including Bitcoin, Ethereum, and USDT. This flexibility allows you to cater to a broader customer base.
How do I ensure instant delivery of my digital products?

You can ensure instant delivery by automating your order processing with tools like Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers. These tools can trigger file delivery immediately upon payment confirmation.
